name: BOSU Ball Plank
steps: Place a BOSU ball dome-side down on the floor and grip the outer rim of the flat platform with both hands shoulder-width apart.
Step your feet back into a high plank so your shoulders stack directly over your wrists and your body forms a straight line.
Brace your abs and glutes firmly while making tiny constant adjustments to keep the platform level.
Hold this level plank steadily for the target duration before stepping safely off the platform.
tips: Keep the platform flat and parallel to the floor rather than letting one side dip downward.
Press actively through your hands and keep your hips aligned with your shoulders.
